00046 class UGenOutput
00047 {
00048 public:
00049  UGenOutput() throw();
00050  ~UGenOutput();
00051  
00052  inline void prepareForBlock(const int actualBlockSize)
00053  {
00054   ugen_assert(actualBlockSize > 0);
00055   
00056   if(externalOutput != 0)
00057   {
00058    ugen_assert(dynamic_cast<UGenOutput*> (externalOutput) != 0);
00059    
00060    externalOutput->prepareForBlock(actualBlockSize);
00061    blockSize = externalOutput->getBlockSize();
00062    block = externalOutput->getSampleData();
00063   }
00064   else if(!usingExternalOutput)
00065   {
00066    blockSize = actualBlockSize;
00067    
00068    if(actualBlockSize > allocatedBlockSize)
00069    {  
00070     delete [] block;
00071     allocatedBlockSize = blockSize;
00072     block = new float[allocatedBlockSize];
00073    }
00074   }
00075  }
00076  //void optimiseBlockSize(); // reduce block sizes to minimum
00077  
00078  inline int getBlockSize() const      { return blockSize;   }
00079  inline float* getSampleData() const     { return block;    }
00080  inline void zeroAllData()       { memset(block, 0, blockSize * sizeof(float)); }
00081  void initValue(const float value) throw();
00082  
00083  void useExternalOutput(UGenOutput* externalOutputToUse);
00084  void useExternalOutput(float* externalOutputToUse, const int externalBlockSize);
00085  
00086 private:
00087  int blockSize;
00088  int allocatedBlockSize;
00089  float *block;
00090  bool usingExternalOutput:1;
00091  UGenOutput* externalOutput;
00092 };
